(b) To produce t he l oad required in sub-paragraph (a) , in unaccelerated flight with zero yaw, at forward speeds from zero up to 0.6 VNE.

(c) To produce t he l oad required in sub-paragraph (a) , in unaccelerated flight with zero yaw, at forward speeds from 0.6 V NE up to VNE or VH, whichever is less:
  (1) Displace the cockpit directional control suddenl y t o t he maximum deflection limited by t he cont rol st ops or by the maximum pilot force specified in CS 29.397(a);
  (2) Attain a resu lting sid eslip an gle or 15°, wh ichever is less, at the lesser speed of VNE or VH;
